title: Supportive Home Remedies for Dry Cough & Sore Throat
content: Warm water gargles with rock salt and organic honey with a pinch of turmeric provide soothing demulcent action for acute dry pharyngeal irritation. Safety: Do not give honey to infants under 12 months (infant botulism risk). Red flags: Seek medical attention if fever exceeds 102Â°F or shortness of breath develops.
